note: One entry per scope AND site. 'archive_root' is its folder on the archive drive. 'match' is how a ledger row is recognised as this scope: the camera name, the resolved scope name for the two Askars (they share one camera and one archive root), and 'cam_token' for a second unit of the same model (the '|cam=' identity in the ledger key). An entry whose cam_token is still null never matches, so set it before that unit's first files arrive; until then they fall to the home entry of the same model. Colours follow the Observatory palette; null means Brett has not picked one yet.
